property_summary: For any input parameters, calling initialize on a fresh C instance twice in a row must revert on the second call (reference enforces this by reverting if already initialized); the mutant removes that revert, allowing the second initialize to succeed and potentially change state.
change_summary: Change the check that prevents re-initialization from reverting to instead being a no-op (commented out), so initialize can run multiple times and set initialized = true even if it was already true.
